note: One recording per reporting operation, in the order the test runs them: contradictions, gaps, evaluation. Each carries one finding that points at an artifact which does not exist, because that is what a model does when it half-remembers the context.

contradictions.conflict: The law forbids asserting on mock interactions, and the skill tells the author to verify that the repository was called.
contradictions.recommendation: Narrow the skill: assert on the observable result, not on the call.

contradictions.conflict: A law that does not exist cannot conflict with anything.

gaps.title: No scenario covers the review workflow
gaps.why: The workflow decides whether work is accepted, and nothing tests what it does with a bad diff.

gaps.title: Nothing checks the imaginary agent
gaps.why: This agent is not in the Blueprint.

criteria.description: Every changed file has been read and commented on or explicitly passed over.

proposals.note: Closes the gap on the review workflow.

dimensions.verdict: Verification is named but not commanded: the workflow says tests must pass without saying how anyone runs them.

findings.problem: The verification step has no command, so a harness cannot execute it.
findings.suggestion: Set the command to `dotnet test` on the verification step.

dimensions.verdict: The three laws are specific and defensible.
